svg.text: Figure 1. Cloud Deployment Architecture (as deployed, AWS ap-southeast-2)
AWS Cloud · Region ap-southeast-2 (Sydney) · Free plan account · stack drugresp-stack (CloudFormation, 43 resources)
Docker container: FastAPI REST API + dashboard
JWT auth + RBAC · 30 GB gp3 encrypted · Elastic IP
IMDSv2 · managed by SSM (no SSH key, port 22 closed)
SG: TCP 5432 only from EC2 SG
disabled to stay within the free tier
Numbered flows: 1 user request (HTTPS) · 2 proxy to application · 3 database · 4 object storage · 5 batch pipeline · 6 deployment (create stack, send-command)
